scope: DB-009G2 fixed-size full-ORM local PG16 statistics candidate experiment

executionIdentity.correction: Added an intermediate unknown type assertion only; no emitted runtime code changed during the successful run.

typecheck.initial: One TS2352 assertion diagnostic; no runtime failure

conclusions: At 100003 rows default ANALYZE sampled 30000; 3/5 samples caused actual warm-auto absent-key full scans. Targets 1000/10000 sampled every row and avoided these absent scans in 5/5 each.
At 1000003 rows target 1000 sampled 300000; 1/5 samples still caused actual warm-auto absent-key full scans. Therefore the 100000-row improvement is not a general fix.
At 1000003 rows target 10000 sampled every row and avoided absent scans in these 5 samples, but warm generic hot checks still built a bitmap of 1000000 index entries, 792 buffers.
ANALYZE wall times are diagnostic observations in fixed order, not randomized cold/warm comparisons or production latency estimates.
The ORM index existed during seeding; earlier migration-focused tests built it after seeding. Do not interpret 82 versus prior 89 hot buffers as a statistics tuning result.
DELETE is the actual parent operation exercised here. This scale experiment is not an UPDATE, runtime-role or production-traffic benchmark.
No retention ceiling, n_distinct override, planner mode override or production statistics migration is justified by this experiment alone. G2 remains open.
